note: P4139 (Pro 20:16) — take a man's garment when he stands surety for a stranger; hold it in pledge. (beged 'garment' = standalone.)

dims.v: surety-securing — take the rash guarantor's garment in pledge
the taking-in-pledge of the garment of one who has rashly stood surety for a stranger
the prudent securing against a foolish guarantor

chabal (bind/take a pledge) — 'hold it in PLEDGE when he puts up security for foreigners'; if a man is rash enough to guarantee a stranger, take his garment as security — his folly makes him a bad risk. Emergent: the pledge-taking that guards against rash surety (cf 6:1-5; 11:15). Prudence about others' imprudence.
